lines.text: The proverb says like mother, like daughter, and Jerusalem's mother was a Hittite and her father an Amorite.
Samaria lived to the north and Sodom to the south, and Jerusalem soon became more depraved than they were.
Sodom was arrogant, overfed and complacent, and Samaria committed half of Jerusalem's sins, so Jerusalem must bear her disgrace.

wrong_details.wrong: Samaria committed half of Jerusalem's sins
wrong_details.true: Samaria did not commit half the sins Jerusalem did

lines.text: God will restore Sodom and Samaria along with Jerusalem, who is now scorned by the daughters of Moab and the Philistines.
Jerusalem broke the covenant, yet God will remember it, establish an everlasting covenant, and make atonement for all she has done.
